evidence.title: fix(cli): reap running monitors when the process dies on an uncaught exception by yiliang114 · Pull Request #11742 · QwenLM/qwen-code · GitHub

name: fix(cli): reap running monitors when the process dies on an uncaught exception
summary: Merged pull request in QwenLM/qwen-code: the CLI reaps monitor processes before exiting on an uncaught exception instead of orphaning them.
description: A merged pull request (#11742) in QwenLM/qwen-code: when the interactive CLI process dies on an uncaught exception, the session-aware handler aborts every running monitor (MonitorRegistry.abortAll with notify: false) before process.exit(1), so the monitor tool group-kills its detached child processes instead of leaving them orphaned and unreachable to a resumed session. Fixes the orphaned-monitor half of #11732.
